title: Nike Gift Card Giveaway (CLOSED)
description: I am giving away a $50 Nike Gift card in celebration of this channel reaching 500 subscribers. I want to thank all of you for your continued support. To enter you must comment in the comment section below what city and state I live in. No abbreviations. Type out the city and state. Also leave a way for me to contact you such as Instagram, Twitter, Gmail etc.. Good luck to all of you. The contest will end on Saturday February 25, 2017. All correct entries will be put into a randomizer and winner will be chosen on Sunday February 26, 2017. 1 entry per person. PLEASE CLICK HERE TO SUBSCRIBE AND ENJOY THIS JOURNEY WITH ME! http://bit.ly/1Z7svNm  LAST VIDEO: Bought my baby niece her First Jordan's https://youtu.be/hz4l7wUsUco

asr.full_text: what this up is everybody and brian and thank you for tuning and not just last Saturday this channel surpassed 500 subscribers and I want to thank every single one of you guys for all the support that i have been receiving lately now in the about section of my youtube channel I have a subscriber milestone that I typed on there and each time I hit that milestone I put the date beside it and each time I hit that milestone I also would like to do a giveaway it's just to show you guys my subscribers the appreciation and as I just mentioned last week I hit 500 subscribers on January 28, 2017. Just one week later and are already…as of now, as I'm filming this at 808 subscribers. Now for my 500 subscriber giveaway, I want to give away a $50 Nike gift card. I have yet to pick up the gift card, but I will soon. I'm going to start the giveaway today, February 4th, 2017, and I'm thinking of letting it run. Let me pull up my calendar here. I'm thinking of letting it run all the way until Saturday, February the 25th, so roughly three weeks. I'm doing three weeks just to give you guys enough time to watch and enter, and give me time to make other content without having to rush to announce a winner. I will end it on February 25, as I mentioned, on Saturday, and on February 26 is when I will do another video to announce the winner now if it's going to be one simple rule for this contest I want you guys in the comment section below to put the city and state that I live in now if you guys are watching in my videos you will already know this answer and I have mentioned it in many of my videos. So again, put the city and the state, for example if I live in Dallas, Texas. I want you guys to comment Dallas Texas fully type it out no abbreviations and please if you could leave a way for me to contact you leave your Instagram or your Twitter or Gmail or something something outside of YouTube so I so I can contact you guys and there's one entry per person if I see multiple entries unfortunately I will have to disqualify that entry all correct entries at the end of this giveaway February 25th I will put into a randomizer on my computer to select to select one winner for a $50 Nike gift card giveaway thank you for all you guys continued support I will leave information to this giveaway in the description box below as well and yeah and stay tuned for more videos I plan on doing more shopping trips more pickups and a special surprise video probably beginning of March as well so stay tuned for that once again thank you guys for all your support if you like this video please give it a thumbs up if you're new to the channel don't forget to subscribe and until my next video see ya!

textual.context: Presented as the creator's subscriber-milestone giveaway and promotional contest. The description title marks it as closed.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is linked to submitting a location answer and an external contact method, creating a reward-plus-requested-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the gift card was obtained, delivered, whether any entrant won, or whether the external contact information was used. They also do not establish that subscribing was required for entry.

textual_context_notes.observation: The contest is described as limited to one entry per person, with correct entries placed into a randomizer and a winner announced on a stated date.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a creator-run subscriber-milestone giveaway for one $50 Nike gift card, identified as closed in the title. Participation involves commenting the creator's city and state and providing an external contact method, with correct entries described as entering a randomizer for one winner. The contact-information request is presented as contest administration, and no payment demand, credential request, deceptive claim, delivery outcome, or connection between subscription prompts and a financial offer is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is a subscriber giveaway offering a gift card through a stated comment-entry and random-selection process.
